name: The Premature Cutting
venue: Kamakis Roadside Butchery and Grounds, Ruiru
description: At the Mutua family nyama choma gathering of January 2013, the meat was cut before Uncle Festus arrived. Uncle Festus had specifically requested that cutting not begin without him. He had been twenty minutes away for one hour and forty minutes. The cutter has not been identified. Uncle Festus has not attended a family gathering since.
prose: The Mutua family nyama choma gathering of 26 January 2013 was convened at Kamakis Roadside Butchery and Grounds, Ruiru, to mark the safe return of Mr. David Mutua from a two-year contract in Qatar. Seventeen family members were present by 1:00 PM. The meat — two whole goats and one hindquarter of beef, totalling an estimated 34 kilograms — had been on the jiko since 11:30 AM and was, by all accounts, ready by 1:45 PM.

Uncle Festus Mutua, the family patriarch and elder brother of the gathering's host, had communicated via phone at 12:30 PM that he was twenty minutes away and that cutting should not commence without him. This request was relayed to the group by the host, Mr. David Mutua, who confirmed it would be honoured. At 1:00 PM Uncle Festus called again to say he was still twenty minutes away. At 1:30 PM he called to say he was almost there. At 2:05 PM he called to say he had been delayed at the petrol station.

At 2:17 PM, someone cut the meat. The event was not witnessed directly by any member of the gathering who has been willing to identify the cutter. The meat was distributed and substantially consumed before Uncle Festus arrived at 2:44 PM. He was presented with a plate that had been set aside. He looked at the plate. He looked at the gathering. He ate in silence. He left before the mandazi.

Uncle Festus has not attended a Mutua family gathering since 26 January 2013. He has acknowledged subsequent invitations with the phrase 'I will try to make it.' He has not tried to make it. The cutter has not come forward. Seven family members, when asked individually by the Heritage Trust, named a different person. The incident is DISPUTED.
heritageTrustNote: The Heritage Trust has conducted informal interviews with nine members of the Mutua family. Nine different accounts of the cutting were given. Two accounts named the same person but disagreed on whether it was deliberate. Uncle Festus declined to give testimony, stating only that he remembered the petrol station.

pullQuote.quote: He looked at that plate for a long time. None of us said anything. The goat had already been eaten. There was nothing to say.

disputedAccount.summary: The identity of the person who cut the meat before Uncle Festus arrived has not been established.

accountA.text: I did not cut it. I was nowhere near the jiko at that time. I was talking to Auntie Grace on the other side of the compound.

accountB.text: James was not talking to me at that time. I was inside the house. The meat was already cut when I came back out.

disputedAccount.heritageTrustNote: The Heritage Trust notes that Auntie Grace's account eliminates James Mutua's alibi without establishing an alternative suspect. Both accounts are preserved in full.
